title: Box queue tee can abort a queued VIXEN build before payload completion
body: The queued VIXEN generation-benchmark build failed before payload completion because queue/tee.rs hit a spare-pipe assertion and SIGPIPE (log 1794809827); an unchanged retry succeeded (log 1794809857). Make with-test-lock capture/backpressure handling robust so a queue transport failure cannot masquerade as a source/build failure or require a manual retry.

title: Native direct-test PowerShell relay does not reap an aborted Windows test
body: The queued vixen-native.sh ps test hit the expected Gaia assertion on iteration 1, but the PowerShell relay stayed alive until a validated PID was explicitly killed (log 1794810838). Give the direct native test route process-tree ownership and bounded reap/exit propagation so a failed Windows test returns promptly without manual cleanup.

title: Gaia single-header generation needs a provisioned formatter
body: The documented single_header target ran during the upstream allocator change and reported 'clang-format : not found - formatting will be skipped'. The generated single_include/gaia.h is valid but the missing formatter expanded a focused allocator change into 562 lines of unrelated formatting churn. Provision clang-format in the Gaia generator environment or make generation deterministic without it, so generated consumer diffs stay reviewable.

title: VIXEN needs a first-class local Gaia source override for unpushed pin witnesses
body: The Round 3 Gaia pin commit was intentionally unpushed, so VIXEN's declared Lint111 remote could not fetch it. To validate native Windows I had to manually clone the local pin worktree into the revision-keyed cache /mnt/c/vixen-native/gaiaarena1/.tmp/fetch/gaia-34cf2534/gaia-src before vixen-native.sh configure/build. Expose a documented provider-root or local-source override that preserves the exact-revision guard on both WSL and native routes, so unpushed fork witnesses do not require manual cache surgery.
